page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c7t.4xlarge is a compute-optimized instance built on x86_64 architecture using KVM hypervisors. It features 16 dedicated virtual CPUs across 8 physical Intel Xeon 8369B cores operating at a base clock speed of 2.7 GHz with 2 threads per core. System memory totals 32.0 GB, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio (2.0 GB per vCPU). The CPU architecture includes 48 KB of L1d cache per core, 1 MB of L2 cache per core, and a 48 MB shared L3 cache array. Hardware acceleration capabilities include instruction set support for AVX, AVX-512 with VNNI, AES, VAES, and SHA_NI for enhanced cryptographic and mathematical calculation tasks.

Network connectivity features a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps without complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The instance does not include local ephemeral storage, requiring network-attached block volumes for operating system and application storage. Dedicated GPU acceleration units are not included in this configuration, shifting computing tasks entirely to the host CPU and system memory infrastructure.

Benchmark results demonstrate consistent average performance tiers across evaluated categories. Compute operations reach a Geekbench single-core score of 1598.0 and a multi-core score of 9553.0, alongside a Passmark CPU score of 21125.85. Memory benchmarks measure read throughput at 95.55 GB/sec for uncached large blocks and write throughput at 56.68 GB/sec. Application testing recorded 15.82 million Redis SET operations per second and 21.07 GB/sec static web serving throughput. Inferencing with a small 135M LLM model achieved 1299.46 prompt tokens/sec and 263.14 generation tokens/sec. This resource profile fits compute-oriented execution environments such as software compilation, web serving, microservice hosting, and batch data processing.
